description_en: Queries user tags for one or more instances
description_zh: 调用ListTagResources查询实例上的用户标签
kebab_example: aliyun servicemesh list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type servicemesh --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Service Mesh (ASM) instance is located
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: A required parameter. The value must be `servicemesh`
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: A list of Service Mesh instance IDs
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key.

The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签键。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value.

The value can be an empty string or a string of up to 128 characters. It cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http\:// or https\://.

Each tag key must have a corresponding tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag key-value pairs at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

标签值可以为空或输入不超过128个字符的字符串，不能以aliyun或者acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。

每一个标签键对应一个标签值，一次最多支持输入20个标签键对应的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: A list of tags. It can contain up to 20 items
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. If this parameter is empty, all results have been returned
parameters.help_zh: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置。显示为空表示数据已经读取完毕
parameters.name: next_token

NextToken.description_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. If this parameter is empty, all results have been returned
NextToken.description_zh: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置。显示为空表示数据已经读取完毕

TagResources.description_en: Information about the queried instances and their tags
TagResources.description_zh: 查询到的集群和标签的信息

items.description_en: Information about the queried resources and their tags
items.description_zh: 查询到资源和标签的信息

ResourceId.description_en: The ID of the Service Mesh instance

ResourceType.description_en: The resource type. The value is `servicemesh`
